title: We Took a Boat Ride
summary: Siswa belajar menceritakan liburan di masa lalu dengan past simple, kosakata transportasi & tempat wisata, serta bertanya "How long did ...?".
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Menceritakan kejadian dan pengalaman liburan di masa lalu.
• Menyebutkan tempat wisata dan kegiatan yang dilakukan di sana.
• Bertanya dan menjawab berapa lama sesuatu berlangsung dengan "How long did ...?".
• Memakai kata kerja bentuk lampau (past simple), termasuk kata kerja tidak beraturan.

## Kosakata Inti

Di unit ini kamu belajar kata-kata tentang liburan: cara bepergian (travel by plane, go by boat, ride the train, take the bus), tempat tujuan (the beach, the mountains, a resort, a village, the city, the forest), dan kegiatan selama liburan (go camping, went sightseeing, bought souvenirs, took photos, tried local food).

We took the bus to the city and went sightseeing.
My family went camping in the forest last summer.
I tried local food and bought souvenirs near the beach.

## Tata Bahasa: Past Simple & "How long did ...?"

Past simple dipakai untuk kegiatan yang sudah selesai di masa lalu (last week, yesterday, last year). Kata kerja beraturan cukup ditambah -ed, sedangkan kata kerja tidak beraturan berubah bentuk:
stay → stayed | travel → traveled
go → went | take → took | ride → rode | buy → bought | see → saw

Untuk bertanya, pakai did + kata kerja dasar: "Where did you go?" (bukan "Where did you went?"). Untuk menanyakan lama waktu, pakai "How long did ...?". Jawab dengan stayed + for + waktu, atau took + waktu (tanpa for).

Where did you go on vacation? — I went to the mountains.
Did you stay at a hotel? — No, we didn't. We stayed at a resort.
How long did you stay at the resort? — We stayed there for two weeks.
How long did the bus ride take? — The bus ride took eight hours.
She rode the train to the beach last weekend.

## Contoh Percakapan

Rani: Hi, Dimas! Where did you go last holiday?
Dimas: I went to Lombok with my family. We traveled by plane.
Rani: Cool! Did you stay at a hotel?
Dimas: No, we didn't. We stayed at a resort near the beach.
Rani: How long did you stay there?
Dimas: We stayed for five days. We also went by boat to a small island.
Rani: How long did the boat ride take?
Dimas: It took one hour. I took a lot of photos and tried local food!

## Ayo Berlatih

Where did you go on your last vacation?
Contoh: I went to my grandparents' village.

How did you get there?
Contoh: We took the bus.

How long did you stay there?
Contoh: We stayed there for four days.

What did you do there?
Contoh: I went sightseeing and bought souvenirs.

## Tips

• Hafalkan kata kerja tidak beraturan secara berpasangan, misalnya go–went, take–took, ride–rode, buy–bought. Buat kartu kecil dan uji dirimu setiap hari.
• Ingat: setelah did, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar. "How long did you stay?" benar, "How long did you stayed?" salah.

questions.q:
Order the events from 1 to 6 in the order they happen. Which number is this event?
"They visited a market and bought souvenirs."
questions.passage: Last weekend, Emma and her family went on a short vacation. They took the bus to a small town near a lake, and they stayed at a small resort by the water. On Saturday morning, they rented a boat and went across the lake. Emma loved the cool wind and the sound of the waves. After the boat ride, they walked through a forest and saw many birds. In the afternoon, they went camping near the mountains and stayed in a tent for one night. On Sunday, they visited a small market and bought souvenirs. Emma bought a keychain for her best friend. Her family took the bus home in the evening, feeling happy and relaxed.
questions.explanation: Urutan dalam teks: naik bus ke kota kecil (1), menginap di resor (2), naik perahu (3), berjalan di hutan (4), berkemah (5), ke pasar membeli suvenir (6). Kejadian ini nomor 6.

notes: Part 1A (mencocokkan kata–arti) diubah menjadi pilihan ganda 4 opsi: arti benar + 3 arti lain dari daftar a–f. Part 2A: kunci PDF "traveled"; ejaan Britania "travelled" juga diterima. Part 2B (menyusun kata) dijadikan FILL_IN kalimat utuh; pencocokan tidak peka huruf besar/kecil, tanda baca akhir boleh dihilangkan, tetapi spasi/kata harus persis sama dengan kunci. Part 3 (mengurutkan kejadian 1–6) dijadikan READING pilihan ganda: tiap kejadian a–f menjadi satu butir dengan opsi 1–6 (kunci a6, b1, c5, d3, e2, f4 sesuai PDF). Tidak ada soal bergambar. Total 31 butir = 31 poin tes.
